notes.title: Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[Game Introduction] In this mysterious campus, you'll experience supernatural phenomena through the eyes of an ordinary college student, exploring with classmates and making new friends. Each day brings unexpected and wonderful adventures!


[Game Features] 
• Unique campus supernatural stories: Experience engaging plots and uncover the campus's mysterious veil
• Beautiful visual style: Perfect fusion of anime aesthetics and supernatural elements. 

Thank you for your support! We hope you enjoy your time in "Sprints School Days"!
